n805255d07be.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Spice monopoly and own coins – Portuguese
n805255d07be.x: Dadni advances and dubashes belonged to the English; the Blue Water Policy was Portuguese and spice monopoly with own coins was Dutch.

n5c1df5efe20.s: The Portuguese held the Arabian Sea trade monopoly until the ____ century.
n5c1df5efe20.x: The Portuguese held the Arabian Sea trade monopoly until the seventeenth century; their decline began with the Dutch arrival in 1605.

nad2dbf8d50b.s: Which was the only French territorial possession in Andhra?
nad2dbf8d50b.x: Yanam, acquired in 1723, was the only French territorial possession in Andhra.

n842085a621a.s: Who defeated Count de Lally at the Battle of Wandiwash in 1760?
n842085a621a.x: Eyre Coote defeated the French commander Count de Lally at Wandiwash in 1760.

nbc25f07b17a.s: Machilipatnam attracted the Portuguese, Dutch, French and English mainly because of its trade in:
nbc25f07b17a.x: Machilipatnam attracted all four European powers because of its important chintz and diamond trade.

nap-history-8-4.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Machilipatnam – Famous for textile and diamond trade
nap-history-8-4.x: Machilipatnam was famed for textile and diamond trade; Motupalli was the Kakatiya port and Ghantasala was Ptolemy's Kantakossyla.

nacf42dfbafa.s: The proposed Nizampatnam and Vodarevu ports in Andhra Pradesh are planned under which model?
nacf42dfbafa.x: The proposed Nizampatnam and Vodarevu ports are under the PPP-BOOT model and were on hold during a CBI investigation.

n116bc0ab1fb.s: Besides Mulapeta, Ramayapatnam and Kakinada SEZ, which is the fourth new port under construction in Andhra Pradesh?
n116bc0ab1fb.x: Machilipatnam is one of the four new ports under construction, the others being Mulapeta, Ramayapatnam and Kakinada SEZ.

n8fcd77f1ce8.s: Sent by Nizam-ul-Mulk as guardian of the minor Nawab, who made himself Nawab of Arcot in 1744?
n8fcd77f1ce8.x: Nizam-ul-Mulk sent Anwaruddin as guardian of the minor Nawab; Anwaruddin had him killed and became Nawab of Arcot in 1744.

na17da42caa7.s: Robert Clive proposed the attack on Arcot during the siege of Trichinopoly mainly to:
o: create a diversion and relieve Muhammad Ali
na17da42caa7.x: Chanda Sahib and the French were besieging Muhammad Ali at Trichinopoly; Clive attacked Arcot, the Carnatic capital, as a diversion.

n8a937973435.s: Which place did Muzaffar Jang grant to Dupleix as a jagir?
n8a937973435.x: Muzaffar Jang made Dupleix Governor of Mughal territory south of the Krishna and gave him Valapadu as a jagir.

n8c6941d7cf6.s: Why did the French Company recall Dupleix in 1754?
o: The heavy cost and failures of his policy of intervention
His surrender of Madras to the English
His grant of the Northern Circars to the English
n8c6941d7cf6.x: The Company was alarmed by the heavy expense and failures of Dupleix's interventionist policy, especially the defeat at Trichinopoly.

nindian-history-17-35.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Count Lally – Led the English side
Treaty of Paris – Ended the First Carnatic War
Third Carnatic War – British fought against the Dutch
British victory in the Third Carnatic War – End of French power in India
nindian-history-17-35.x: The British victory in the Third Carnatic War ended French power in India; Lally led the French, and the Treaty of Paris (1763) concluded the Third war.

nd0fb46bcead.s: Which feature distinguished the English East India Company from the French company?
o: It was a private company with a yearly elected board
nd0fb46bcead.x: The English company was privately organised with a yearly elected board and quicker decisions; the French company was state-controlled.

n557c1337f31.s: Which French commander quarrelled with his officers and failed to understand Indian conditions?
n557c1337f31.x: Lally's quarrels with his officers and poor grasp of Indian conditions weakened the French effort.

n7312247aab9.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n7312247aab9.x: The Third Carnatic War was fought in 1756–63; the First was 1746–48 and the Second 1749–54.

n79b7de5ac6d.s: At the Battle of St. Thome (Adyar), 1746, about 930 French troops defeated roughly 10,000 men of:
n79b7de5ac6d.x: At St. Thome/Adyar (1746) about 930 French troops beat about 10,000 of the Nawab's men.

n3b09eeedbb8.s: Which battle is commonly called the foundation of British rule in India?
n3b09eeedbb8.x: Plassey is commonly called the foundation of British rule, though some assessments treat Buxar as the more decisive battle.

n49486314260.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Sarfaraz Khan – Stopped both companies fortifying Calcutta and Chandannagar
Alivardi Khan – Killed Shaukat Jang at Manihari
Siraj-ud-Daulah – Killed Shaukat Jang at Manihari
n49486314260.x: Siraj-ud-Daulah killed Shaukat Jang at Manihari; Sarfaraz Khan was killed by Alivardi, who stopped the fortifications.

nindian-history-17-37.s:
Consider the following statements about the Battle of Buxar:
1. The British fought against Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II.
2. The British won the battle.
3. It was followed by the Treaty of Allahabad in 1765.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-17-37.x: All three are correct: at Buxar (1764) the British defeated Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula and Shah Alam II, and the Treaty of Allahabad (1765) followed.

n9505e56f4f0.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Robert Clive – Naib Diwan at Murshidabad
Raja Shitab Rai – Naib Diwan in Bihar
Muhammad Reza Khan – Abolished Dual Government
n9505e56f4f0.x: Shitab Rai was Naib Diwan in Bihar; Reza Khan was Naib Diwan at Murshidabad, Clive introduced and Hastings abolished the Dual Government.

nf11a3ddc7c5.s: Which of the following monuments at Srirangapatna is correctly matched?
o: Gumbaz – Mausoleum of Haidar Ali and Tipu Sultan
Jamia Masjid – Summer palace with war murals
Daria Daulat Bagh – Mausoleum of Haidar Ali and Tipu Sultan
nf11a3ddc7c5.x: The Gumbaz is the mausoleum of Haidar Ali and Tipu Sultan; Daria Daulat Bagh is the summer palace and Jamia Masjid is Masjid-e-Ala.

nindian-history-91-13.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-91-13.x: The Doctrine of Lapse belongs to Dalhousie; the Subsidiary Alliance was Wellesley's and the Blue Water Policy was Francisco de Almeida's.

n32ab88c4f78.s: Who negotiated the 1818 treaties with Jodhpur, Jaipur, Bundi and other Rajput states?
n32ab88c4f78.x: Charles Metcalfe negotiated the treaties with the Rajput states in 1818 under Lord Hastings.

nindian-history-91-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nindian-history-91-6.x: The Ring Fence policy was Warren Hastings'; Dhamma was Ashoka's, Market Control Alauddin Khalji's and Blood and Iron Balban's.

o: a dubashi and envoy between the Nizam's court and the Company
the first Collector of the Ceded Districts
a poligar who resisted the Company in Rayalaseema
the zamindar of Vizianagaram defeated at Padmanabham
n8dfbf4cc36c.x: Kandregula Jogipantulu was a prominent dubashi and envoy between the Nizam's court and the Company's men at Machilipatnam.

n7632084943a.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n7632084943a.x: The Treaty of Masulipatnam was 1768; Salabat Jung's grant was 1759, the Circar lease 1766 and the Treaty of Hyderabad 1798.

n429eac2c0fc.s: In the Bobbili War (1757), Vijayarama Raju of Vizianagaram took the help of:
n429eac2c0fc.x: Vijayarama Raju took French help through Bussy during the Bobbili War of 1757.

n0914abbac62.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
n0914abbac62.x: Read and Munro conducted the Baramahal experiment in 1792; Munro's Ceded Districts experiment dates to 1802.

nb0e861e974e.s: After Chinna Vijayarama Raju's defeat at Padmanabham (1794), who was placed over Vizianagaram's forts?
nb0e861e974e.x: After the defeat, the minor son Narayana Babu was made zamindar and George Russell was placed in charge of Vizianagaram's forts.

nap-history-18-1.s: Who designed and constructed the Dowleswaram Anicut in 1852?
nap-history-18-1.x: Sir Arthur Cotton designed and built the Dowleswaram Anicut across the Godavari, completed in 1852.

n1021a84b8de.s: The Godavari and Krishna deltas are together known as the ____ of Andhra.
n1021a84b8de.x: The Godavari and Krishna deltas are called the Rice Bowl of Andhra because of their importance for rice cultivation.

n662b9ee3200.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Arthur Cotton – Ryotwari and suppression of the palegars
Colin Mackenzie – Surveyor General and preservation of records
C.P. Brown – Godavari and Krishna anicuts
Thomas Munro – Telugu revival and manuscript-library work
n662b9ee3200.x: Colin Mackenzie preserved records as Surveyor General; Cotton built the anicuts, Brown led Telugu revival and Munro introduced ryotwari.

ncb70d93d709.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
ncb70d93d709.x: Gujrat and Chillianwala belonged to the Second Anglo-Sikh War; Mudki and Sobraon to the First.

nb74aa18a842.s: Which of the following is correctly matched with the ground of its British annexation?
o: Sindh and Punjab – Doctrine of Lapse
nb74aa18a842.x: Awadh and Coorg were taken for misgovernance; Sindh and Punjab by conquest, Satara to Nagpur by lapse, and Carnatic and Tanjore by abolition of titles.

n503ffee7a1c.s:
Arrange in chronological order:
1. Treaty of Salbai
2. Battle of Wandiwash
3. Death of Tipu Sultan
4. Hanging of Nand Kumar
n503ffee7a1c.x: Wandiwash 1760, Nand Kumar hanged 1775, Treaty of Salbai 1782 and Tipu's death 1799.

n58ef9218743.s: Which treaty is correctly matched with the Governor-General of its time?
n58ef9218743.x: Amritsar (1809) was concluded under Minto I; Salbai belongs to Warren Hastings and Lahore to Hardinge I.

nindian-history-134-16.s:
Consider the following statements about Lord Canning:
1. His tenure was 1856–1862.
2. He was the last Governor-General under the Company and the first Viceroy under the Crown.
3. The Allahabad High Court was established in 1866 during his tenure.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-134-16.x: Canning served 1856–1862 as the last Company Governor-General and first Crown Viceroy; his term ended before the Allahabad High Court came in 1866.

n811305b8d01.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Lord Northbrook — Abolition of income tax
n811305b8d01.x: The Second Factory Act was passed under Lord Lansdowne in 1891, not Ripon; the other three pairs are correct.

nindian-history-125-2.s: Which Viceroy is correctly matched with his tenure?
nindian-history-125-2.x: Lawrence served 1864–1869; Canning 1856–1862, Mayo 1869–1872 and Lytton 1876–1880.

nd3812c6f121.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Chelmsford — Rowlatt Act and Jallianwala Bagh tragedy
nd3812c6f121.x: The Rowlatt Act and Jallianwala Bagh (1919) came under Chelmsford; Quit India and the August Offer belong to Linlithgow, and the Gandhi-Irwin Pact to Irwin.

nindian-history-106-16.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Lord Linlithgow is associated with the Second World War and the August Offer.
2. Lord Linlithgow is associated with the Cripps Mission and Quit India.
3. Lord Wavell is associated with the First Afghan War.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
nindian-history-106-16.x: Linlithgow saw the Second World War, the August Offer, the Cripps Mission and Quit India; the First Afghan War belongs to Lord Auckland, not Wavell.

nindian-history-125-14.s: Which Viceroy is correctly matched with his tenure?
nindian-history-125-14.x: Willingdon served 1931–1936; Irwin served 1926–1931, Linlithgow from 1936 and Wavell from the mid-1940s to 1947.
